test_title: PYST 38 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Intelligence (Held On: 26 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: 8 boys A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting in a row facing south (not necessarily in the same order). A and H are at extreme ends of the row. E and F are immediate neighbours of B. C is fourth to the left of B. F is to the immediate left of A. D is not the immediate neighbour of C. Who is sitting third to the right of E?
solution:
8 boys A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting in a row facing south (not necessarily in the same order).

1. A and H are at extreme ends of the row.

2. E and F are immediate neighbours of B.

3. C is fourth to the left of B.

4. F is to the immediate left of A.

4. D is not the immediate neighbour of C. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e22ed54e1957c9ed430ceccb471b948d5f2ca5e67d2fe78ccc94efbb2cef2f48.png] 

A is sitting third to the right of E.

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 3**”.
